lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 6 visible vertical lines. The posterior-most line is high-contrast and approximately double the width of the others. Spacing is widest between the first and second posterior lines, with subsequent lines appearing more closely and regularly spaced.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The third and fourth lines from the posterior exhibit mid-torso attenuation, failing to maintain a continuous pixel path to the ventral fringe.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns follow a lyrate trajectory, diverging at approximately 50 degrees from the skull before spiraling medially and anteriorly.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated pixel distance between terminal tips is 2.1 times the width of the combined horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping represents approximately 18% of the total horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: White chevron between eyes; two white spots on the lower cheek; prominent white dorsal mane; dark ventral hair fringe; white lower leg markings with distinct black bands above the joints.
